description: This file defines a class 'AccessControl' that provides static methods for managing ownership and permissions of filesystem nodes (files or directories) on POSIX systems. It includes methods to set ownership based on username and group name, set permissions, and apply both ownership and permissions to a specified node using its attributes.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions on POSIX systems.

methods.name: uint32_t OwnerShip(const string & node,const string & userName,const string & groupName)
methods.description: Sets the owner and group of a file node based on provided username and group name.

methods.name: uint32_t Permission(const string & node,const uint16_t modeFlags)
methods.description: Sets the permission mode of a file node based on mode flags.

methods.name: uint32_t Apply(const Core::NodeId & node)
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a node based on its attributes.
